name: print-social-dark-values-post-with-gold-line-icons-and-dusk-building
title: Four company values with gold line icons above a lit dusk apartment complex
whatItIs: A black portrait post with a 2x2 grid of values (Quality, Transparency, Innovation, Sustainability), each with a gold outline icon, bold caps title and short white text separated by hairlines, fading into a photo of two lit green-roofed apartment buildings at dusk.
whatItMeans: Premium and orderly; gold on black feels upscale, and the photo grounds the claims.
techniques: Use thin gold line icons on black.
Split values into a 2x2 grid with hairline dividers.
Fade the top of a photo into the black.

vocabulary.definition: An icon drawn with a thin outline.
An image dissolving into a solid colour.
